    <rect id="c-proof" x="64" y="824" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Representative users complete the supported account/SSO journey.<br>• Required web/Git/API actions work; restricted repos/actions stay denied.<br>• Base, team, inherited and direct access match the agreed model.<br>• Joiner/mover/leaver changes and remaining credentials are tested.<br>• Sync/session behavior, audit evidence, support and recovery are verified." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690640001573" />
    <rect id="c-dependencies" x="1656" y="824" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Verified hosting/plan/account model and supported Entra features.<br>• Organization/enterprise owners, Entra admins and repository owners.<br>• Membership/group/team inventory and baseline task-to-role matrix.<br>• Restricted-source classifications and repository consolidation scope.<br>• Pilot users, recovery path, audit access and maintained user guidance." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690640001574" />
    <rect id="c-controls" x="64" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Reviewed group-to-team mappings and repository-role changes.<br>• Meaningful names, stable identifiers and accountable owners.<br>• Organization base permissions, direct access and collaborator review.<br>• Tested provisioning, membership removal and credential handling.<br>• Staged migration, administrative recovery and recurring access review." fill="#ffe86d" stroke="#cbb333" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690640001575" />
    <rect id="c-decisions" x="1656" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Personal accounts + SAML SSO or Enterprise Managed Users?<br>• What plan/features and organization/enterprise integration scope?<br>• Which groups/teams, base permissions, repository roles and owners?<br>• How are outside collaborators and restricted sources handled?<br>• Which approvals, removal rules, support and elevation mechanisms apply?" fill="#ffe86d" stroke="#cbb333" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690640001576" />
    <rect id="c-boundaries" x="64" y="1504" width="3024" height="160" data-content="<b>Identity, membership and repository authorization are separate checks</b><br>Use the selected account model’s provisioning/group mechanism and verify <a href="https://docs.github.com/en/organizations/managing-user-access-to-your-organizations-repositories/managing-repository-roles/repository-roles-for-an-organization">GitHub repository roles</a>. Team synchronization is not a substitute for establishing organization membership.<br>Coordinate source-access boundaries with 02–04 and documentation with 06. Any temporary GitHub elevation needs its own supported design in 10; no automatic Google Cloud PAM-to-GitHub grant is assumed." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690640001577" />
